description: This Java class handles the approval process of a GLIM (Group Lending with Individual Monitoring) loan application within the Fintech framework. It implements a command handler to process approval commands.

classes.name: GLIMLoanApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing loan application approval commands for GLIM loans, annotated with service and command type metadata.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the approval command for a GLIM loan application, invoking the service to approve the loan using the command's entity ID.
